text:
Elliot: FYI ran into a nasty combo: TS generics + overloads + ESM/CJS conditional exports when building the edge sample. Types fail and runtime methods missing.
Sam: paste the errors and tsconfig.
Elliot: errors: 'TS2345: Argument of type \"unknown\" is not assignable to parameter of type \"T\"' and 'No overload matches this call to client.stream()'. Runtime: client.stream is undefined unless I change imports.
Priya: what import style are you using?
Elliot: default import: `import Redwood from \"@redwood/inference\"`.
Maya: switch to named import: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` — default interop breaks across bundlers when conditional exports point to CJS for some resolvers.
Elliot: named import fixed the runtime missing-method. TS still complains about generics on `client.chat<{ id: number }>(...)` only when moduleResolution is bundler.
Sam: bundlers can change which .d.ts entry TS resolves. Quick dev fix: set "moduleResolution": "node16" or add "skipLibCheck": true. CI should still test strict paths.
Priya: long-term: we should ship a types entry that bundlers consistently pick up for edge, e.g., "types/edge/index.d.ts", and include it in exports map.
Maya: also our retry/auth code calls node-only methods in error handlers; edge fetch doesn't have the same shapes. Add guards instead of assuming request.destroy().
Elliot: small repro:
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new RedwoodClient();
await c.chat<{ foo: string }>('hi');
```
Sam: I suspect overloads in the public API use conditional mapped types that get lost; simplify to a single generic with a default and provide strict helper types.
Priya: proposal: keep ergonomic overloads for js users, add an opt-in `import type { StrictClient } from '@redwood/inference/strict'` for TS power users.
Maya: action items:
- Sam: add CI matrix: node cjs/esm, edge esbuild/rollup, TS strict (owner: Sam)
- Priya: draft typings plan and a `types/edge` entry (owner: Priya)
- Maya: harden retry/auth for non-Node environments (owner: Maya)
- Elliot: add repro under examples/edge-ts with recommended tsconfig (owner: Elliot)
bot-ci: created issue RED-812 for edge typing + exports parity + retry mismatch https://issues.internal/RED-812
Elliot: will push example and link. ping #devex if you hit similar flakes.
